title: Capcom REX: RE Engine upgrades toward an engine AI can work with; ties to the RAM shortage

versions.change: voiced ANALYSIS card from his take

sources.name: Capcom Open Conference RE:2026 talk, as reported by gamebiz

claims.text: REX adds RE: systems to RE Engine in stages, not a new engine
27+ titles on RE Engine; 2,000+ developers use it
Goal: an 'AI-generation' engine where AI understands code, helps write it, test-plays for bugs

why: His take: AI used the helpful way, and the AI boom is why RAM and console prices climb.

dxb.x: Most AI talk in games is about replacing artists. Capcom is pointing it somewhere players never see: the engine, the code, the bug testing. / That's the kind I can get behind. And the irony writes itself: the thing driving RAM and console prices up might also be what wins studios their time back.
